results.question: Which bin location, warehouse zone, and quality lot number contain active stock for Enterprise Laptops (SKU-LAPTOP-15-ENT)?

SELECT l.lot_number, l.sku_code, l.qa_status, p.bin_code, b.zone_code, b.shelf_level
